reason: The handlers use only the booking service and the layers keep their dependency order, with fees from the injected policy and events sent through the bus.
api/handlers.py imports domain.schedule.Slot and constructs a Slot directly to validate input, so the handlers reach the domain without going through the application.

ReminderService.run_for imports adapters.email_notifier.OutboxNotifier and replaces the injected notifier with a new one, so the application depends on an adapter and reminders bypass the injected notifier.
The book handler calls service._appointments.on_day(day), reaching the appointment store through an object reachable from the service.
BookingService.cancel builds its own LateCancellationFee(24, 30) instead of using the injected policy, so the fee does not come from the injected policy.
